genreClassification.rationale: The song 'Antisocial' by Trust is a classic example of aggressive, raw punk rock.

Ollama.targetTone: Mid-gain, fuzzy crunch with a thick, slightly scooped midrange and pronounced low end.
gearHypotheses: High-gain fuzz pedal (e.g., Big Muff style)
Mid-gain overdrive pedal (e.g., Tube Screamer variant)
Amp simulation with robust low end and mid scoop capability

finalVerdict.targetTone: dry punk/hardcore crunch with sharp mids and tight palm-mutes

gp180.choicePolicy: Focus on aggressive, mid-forward crunch suitable for punk/hardcore rhythm playing.
gp180.bestMatchSummary: A tight signal chain utilizing a Boost and Distortion pedal to achieve raw aggression, paired with the UK 45 amp model and UK Vintage 4x12 cab for classic Plexi-style punch and bite.

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain rhythm playing and palm-muting.

alternatives.reason: If more distinct tube saturation is desired.

blocks.purpose: Provide the raw, aggressive crunch and mid-forward bite required for punk/hardcore rhythm.
